instruction: Copy the text from Cell C3 in this Calc spreadsheet and look it up on Google using Chrome browser.

metadata.explanation: Task asks to copy cell C3 (Last Name column, row 3) from the spreadsheet and search it in Chrome. Verified from Excel file: Row 3, Column C contains 'Gent'. Evaluator checks if active tab URL matches Google search for 'gent'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if correct Google search performed, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_active_tab_info' reloads the active tab page (line 852: page.goto(active_tab_url)), which can alter the verification state
Page reload on dynamic search pages may trigger redirects or change URL parameters, potentially causing false negatives
Getter documentation explicitly warns: 'This function will reload the target-url page' and 'If the target url has cache or cookie, this function may reload to another page'
No postconfig present to ensure search state remains accessible after agent task completion
Metric logic is correct: regex pattern properly matches Google search URL with query parameter 'q=gent'
Expected value is semantically correct: verified that cell C3 contains 'Gent' from source data
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks the main requirement (Google search for the cell content)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace 'get_active_tab_info' with 'get_active_url_from_accessTree' to avoid page reload - this getter only reads the URL from accessibility tree without navigating
Update evaluator.result.type from 'active_tab_info' to 'active_tab_url' to match the simpler getter
Alternative: Add postconfig to reopen/refresh Chrome to ensure search state is still active before verification
